==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis.
This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Storyverse. (The Storyverse is a multiverse where all possible story ideas exist as cosmic bubble universes that float together in a cosmic void.) (I initially spent most of my time in one particular world in the Storyverse called the Elven Village, which I discovered on 06/11/2025.) (My team includes Leon, Johnson, Second Brain, Skelebot, Overdrive, and I.) (My Ghostly UFO, named Leon, resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow. Leon first appeared in my dreams on 06/11/2025.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet. I befriended him in a dream on 08/03/2025.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light. I created him in a dream on 09/06/2025. On the same day I created Second Brain, he helped me discover the much wider Storyverse. This was the start of my adventures to explore other Storyverse worlds.) (Overdrive is a robot with a metallic chrome color with spiky slicked back yellow hair and glowing green eyes. It wears a yellow shirt, yellow jacket, yellow pants, and yellow sneakers. They have the power to manipulate matter, and they were created in a dream on 10/20/2025.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars. I discovered the power of Lucid Light in a dream on 07/19/2025.) (Skelebot is a robot created by Johnson to act as the team's humanoid speedster. He was created in a dream on 09/21/2025.)
My mind is partially hijacked by a general of the Cosmic Sea. (The general has the ability to psychically tap into and pilot someone's body from a distance. I could feel his presence in my mind, I was conscience of what he was doing, but I couldn't reassert control over my body. The general resembled a gray humanoid trout wearing a white military general uniform.) (I first learned about the Cosmic Sea in a dream on 08/23/2025. The Cosmic Sea resembles a colorful ocean in space populated by giant fish and Were-Fish.) (The general's power heavily reminds me of Cipher's power from Gen V. I actually watched some Gen V yesterday, so that likely influenced my dream. I wonder if I subconsciously was curious about whether or not I could defeat someone with Cipher's abilities.)
I reverse the connection in order to travel as Lucid Light to his location. (Similar to tracing a phone call to its source, I used the psychic connection he established to send a Lucid Light construct of myself directly to his location.)
I quickly learn he is trying to trick us into fighting innocent Were-Sharks, so I rally the sharks against him to take him down. (The general was corrupt. He was trying to use our old biases against us to help him amass power for himself. He was a powerful psychic, but he underestimated the power of Lucid Light.) (We have battled Were-Sharks in the past, but that was when their leader was corrupted. We last battled the Were-Sharks in a dream on 08/16/2025. Their leader, the Trident Wielder, is no longer corrupted since the events of a dream from 08/27/2025. In other words, the Were-Sharks actually haven't been evil for months. The general of the Cosmic Sea was just jealous of the Trident Wielder, and wanted to use my crew and I to do his dirty work by taking down his rival's forces. He wanted to be the big hero, to outshine the Trident Wielder, but in the process he ended up becoming the villain.)
